info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Healthcare Appointments Providers-v3-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Providers API provides access to a comprehensive list of healthcare providers available for appointments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various providers, including their specialties, availability, and contact information. It serves healthcare applications and platforms that aim to facilitate patient-provider interactions and enhance scheduling efficiency. Ideal for developers integrating appointment management into healthcare solutions, this API ensures users can easily find and connect with the right healthcare professionals.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of available providers for appointments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the providers that can be scheduled for appointments, providing essential information for users looking to book a service.
